spec.goal: Build the two-day program of the conference from the talk submissions and the speakers' emails. Place every talk on the rooms x slots grid of one day, in its own track, with no room or speaker double-booked, every speaker available at their slot, every room big enough for its expected audience, and never two talks of one track at the same time. Honor the speakers' time preferences where possible, and write a short blurb per session.
